title: Cracking Earthquake (cracking soil, cracking stone)
author: uagadugu
description: The sound of an earthquake cracking open the soil. Freesound samples used: "EARTHQUAKE OR DISTANT SPACE SHUTTLE RUMBLE.WAV" by genelythgow (freesound.org/people/genelythgow/sounds/203281) "Digging.wav" by prozaciswack (freesound.org/people/prozaciswack/sounds/82722) Further samples of stones, wooden bricks, etc. recorded via Rode NT2A -> Focusrite Saffire Liquid 56. Processed and mixed in Ableton Live 9.
